summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Bharadwaja’s harsh statecraft teachings to King Satrunjaya on power, strategy, spies, and ruthless survival during times of social decay.

image_candidates.scene_text: A stern king sits with a raised rod of chastisement while frightened subjects and courtiers stand before him in a dim royal hall.
A disguised spy in ascetic robes with matted hair secretly observes enemies in a bustling foreign marketplace.
A king smashes an earthen jar on a stone to symbolize destroying an enemy once the moment of opportunity arrives.
